TERMS/create: two terms in key-terms.md with no existing notes produce two concept notes in wiki/concepts/ with aliases parsed, verbatim source block stored, History stamped; lexicon.md regenerated with two rows

TERMS/change-detection: one term's text edited, one untouched. Only the edited note changes — updated bumped, History gains a timestamped line with the prior text. The untouched note is byte-identical.
TERMS/archive: a term removed from key-terms.md sets status: archived on its note, appends a History line, and moves it to the lexicon's archived section. The file is NOT deleted.

TERMS/precedence + conflict: the same term in key-terms.md and as a [define] line resolves to key-terms.md with the loser recorded in History; a hand-edited concept note overwritten by key-terms.md is reported explicitly, never silently

PROFILE: an item that fits no declared domain lands in the default domain; an item needing an undeclared type is filed under the closest existing type and the new type is PROPOSED in the report, not self-authorized
